mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM purchase_demand_allocation a JOIN purchase_order_item oi ON oi.id = a.purchase_order_item_id AND oi.deleted = FALSE WHERE a.deleted = FALSE AND oi.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} ORDER BY a.purchase_order_item_id ASC, a.purchase_demand_id ASC
SELECT * FROM purchase_demand_allocation WHERE deleted = FALSE AND purchase_order_item_id IN #{it} ORDER BY purchase_order_item_id ASC, purchase_demand_id ASC
SELECT * FROM purchase_demand_allocation WHERE deleted = FALSE AND purchase_demand_id IN #{it} ORDER BY purchase_demand_id ASC, id ASC

SELECT a.* FROM purchase_demand_allocation a JOIN purchase_order_item oi ON oi.id = a.purchase_order_item_id AND oi.deleted = FALSE WHERE a.deleted = FALSE AND oi.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} AND a.purchase_demand_id IN #{it} ORDER BY a.purchase_order_item_id ASC, a.purchase_demand_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE purchase_demand_allocation SET deleted = TRUE, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE purchase_order_item_id = #{purchaseOrderItemId} AND deleted = FALSE
